scopeRule: vNext is a greenfield rebuild of the current product contract, not a migration of historical physical tables. A source concept with an explicitly removed subsystem or no current producer/consumer after exhaustive connected-source review may be retired from the current product schema. A later external integration must be modeled from its actual current contract rather than reviving a historical table by name.

guardrails: This decision applies only to the current vNext product schema; it does not claim the historical tables never existed in deployed MySQL.
No historical data migration/backfill is required.

A future external integration is a new product contract and must receive a separately tracked schema/API/security design.
